errorCodes.meaning: `subject` already holds an access-control entry of a role other than `application`. An entry with no member record is made a membership with vtc/members/make-membership, which keeps its role and authority.
`subject` already holds a member record that has not been removed.

The community does not recognise `role`, or it may not be seated by a direct admission (`admin`, `application`, or a role whose authority would confer authority-conferring capabilities), or the requester may not assign it: a role other than `member` takes the role-assignment capability and must lie within the requester's own authority.
The community's admission policy refuses this admission.

AdmittedMembership.description: A membership admitted directly, with the credentials issued for it — the success payload of vtc/members/admit and vtc/members/make-membership.

label.description: The new entry's label, when vtc/members/admit was given one. Absent for vtc/members/make-membership, which writes no entry.

returning.description: True when vtc/members/admit re-admitted a former member (a removed member record, no entry), as a rejoin would re-admit them. Always false for vtc/members/make-membership, which refuses a removed record.

role.description: The community role the membership holds: for vtc/members/admit the one requested, for vtc/members/make-membership the role the entry already held.

roleVac.description: The role credential issued for the admission: a Verifiable Authority Credential issued by the community whose `credentialSubject.authority` is `{ scope: <community DID>, actions: ["role:<name>"] }`, the shape vtc/join-requests/decide returns.

status.description: Always `admitted`: a refusal is a trust-task-error, and a referred admission is answered with trust-task-next-step until it executes.

statusListIndex.description: The membership's slot on the community's revocation status list, which the VMC's credentialStatus names.

vmc.description: The Verifiable Membership Credential issued for the admission, delivered inline as vtc/join-requests/decide delivers it.

AdmittedMembership.title: AdmittedMembership

Approval.description: How the admission came to execute. `policyAllowed`: the community's policy admitted it at once. `approved`: the policy referred it, the community parked it, and another administrator approved it. `waived`: the policy referred it, and the community's single-administrator mode waived the approval on the requester's own re-authentication bound to the operation.
Approval.title: Approval

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: Success response to vtc/members/admit/0.1: the membership as admitted, with the credentials issued for it. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/members/admit/0.1#response — carried directly, or on the request's threadId when a referred operation executes after its approval.
Response.title: VTC Members Admit — response payload

schema.description: An administrator admits a DID as a member of the community without a join request, at a community role it names.

label.description: A human-readable label for the new access-control entry, as `acl/grant` carries one. Confers nothing. Not blank.

reason.description: Why, for the community's audit trail and for the administrators asked to approve it if the admission is referred. Never published to the subject or beyond the community.

role.description: The community role the membership will hold, in the community's wire form (`member`, `moderator`, `issuer`, `custom:<name>`). Required, so that what an approver is shown is what was asked for. Never `admin`, never `application`, and never a role whose authority would confer authority-conferring capabilities; a role other than `member` is subject to the role-assignment rules of Conformance item 3.

subject.description: The DID to admit. It holds no access-control entry at the community, or only one of the `application` community role (a non-member holding resource grants), and no live membership.

schema.title: VTC Members Admit — payload
